versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 introduces the initial release of doubao-image-video-skill for ByteDance/Doubao (Volcengine ARK) API integration.

- Provides CLI and Python API for text-to-image, image editing (e.g. watermark removal), and text-to-video generation.
- Supports asynchronous and synchronous video generation, along with task status checking.
- Includes troubleshooting tips and detailed usage documentation.
- Requires Python 3.7+ and ARK_API_KEY setup.
- Offers example commands and code for quick start and testing.
